newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia building sector seen rising in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia building sector seen rising in 1997.

text.p: Australia's house-building industry would rise in 1997, boosted by strong population growth and sound fiscal policy, the Housing Industry Association (HIA) said on Monday.

"Our forecasts suggest that Australian housing starts bottomed in the recent June quarter and will be moving up in the second half of 1996 and throughout 1997," the association said in its September quarterly review.
Total building activity would rise nine percent in 1997 after a fall of seven percent in 1996, it said.

Housing and non-residential building would be pushed up in calendar 1997 by the prospects of continued economic growth and lower interest rates, on the back of strong population growth and a sound budget, the association said.

Australia's conservative government announced a tough budget for fiscal 1996/97 (July-June), slashing spending by A$3.9 billion and halving the underlying deficit to A$5.3 billion from A$10.6 billion in 1995/96.
